summary: Implemented static directive registry inspection commands: bwrk directives list supports family and status filters including active/deprecated/removed, bwrk directives show exposes data requirements and replacement metadata, command registry metadata/docs were updated, and focused regression coverage was added.
command: pnpm exec tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json apps/cli/tsconfig.json --pretty false; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli-agent-directives.test.ts; pnpm exec vitest run tests/runtime/cli.test.ts -t 'exposes the registered command surface as JSON|generates shell completions from the command registry|parses value flags from the command registry|documents every current command group'; bwrk directives list --family closeout --status active --json; bwrk directives show closeout.summary-required --json
